title: Reading Comfort Profiles
user: Knowledge workers with low vision who need readable text, code, tables, and density settings across web-based work apps without changing every site manually.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension with keyboard-switchable per-domain profiles for base font, line height, code font, contrast, cursor/focus visibility, and optional table spacing; all settings stay locally.
success_measure: In a four-week accessibility pilot, at least 70% of participants retain profiles on three or more work domains and report fewer manual zoom changes per day.
constraints: Must not break keyboard navigation or application layouts; follow WCAG guidance; no browsing-history collection; provide a one-key disable switch.
